Use in this game: calligraphy headings, action labels, and 3D paper lettering.
LXGW WenKai TC remains the readable text face and fallback for rare characters.
The font follows Hong Kong primary-school character forms for its 4,762 revised
characters. The complete binary contains additional original CNS Kai glyphs.
The game is an independent educational work; no endorsement is implied.
